hooks.name: session-sync
hooks.description: Saves session data to Work Session Service before context compaction

hooks.name: credential-exposure
hooks.description: Detects a real credential reaching the assistant's context, tells it to disclose and rotate immediately, and records the incident locally. Never echoes what it found. Parses with python3, not jq: v1.0.0 used jq while the installer only required python3, so it was silently inert on any machine without jq. `--check` now self-tests detection rather than presence.
